post.desc:
Create or update deployment records for an artifact associated with an organization.
This endpoint allows you to record information about a specific artifact, such as its name, digest, environments, cluster, and deployment.

params.name: org
params.desc: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

digest.description: The hex encoded digest of the artifact.

status.description: The status of the artifact. Can be either deployed or decommissioned.

physical_environment.description: The physical region of the deployment.

tags.description: The tags associated with the deployment.

runtime_risks.description: A list of runtime risks associated with the deployment.

github_repository.description:
The name of the GitHub repository associated with the artifact. This should be used
when there are no provenance attestations available for the artifact. The repository
must belong to the organization specified in the path parameter.

If a provenance attestation is available for the artifact, the API will use
the repository information from the attestation instead of this parameter.

List webhooks for an organization.

The authenticated user must be an organization owner to use this endpoint.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need `admin:org_hook` scope. OAuth apps cannot list, view, or edit
webhooks that they did not create and users cannot list, view, or edit webhooks that were created by OAuth apps.

post.desc:
Create a hook that posts payloads in JSON format.

You must be an organization owner to use this endpoint.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need `admin:org_hook` scope. OAuth apps cannot list, view, or
edit webhooks that they did not create and users cannot list, view, or edit webhooks that were created by OAuth apps.

params.name: org
params.desc: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

config.description: Key/value pairs to provide settings for this webhook.

url.description: The URL to which the payloads will be delivered.

content_type.description: The media type used to serialize the payloads. Supported values include `json` and `form`. The default is `form`.

secret.description: If provided, the `secret` will be used as the `key` to generate the HMAC hex digest value for [delivery signature headers](https://docs.github.com/webhooks/event-payloads/#delivery-headers).

oneOf.description: Determines whether the SSL certificate of the host for `url` will be verified when delivering payloads. Supported values include `0` (verification is performed) and `1` (verification is not performed). The default is `0`. **We strongly recommend not setting this to `1` as you are subject to man-in-the-middle and other attacks.**

events.description: Determines what [events](https://docs.github.com/webhooks/event-payloads) the hook is triggered for. Set to `["*"]` to receive all possible events.

active.description: Determines if notifications are sent when the webhook is triggered. Set to `true` to send notifications.
